description:
Not built: the re-profile shows nothing worth a commit.

Profile: release binary at fz-e7w.2 (34ec1a9d9), the issue's program at n = 1,280,000, macOS sample, 2060 samples (inclusive shares overlap):
- step_eval_entry 58.4%, eval_backend_direct_call_edge 20.1%, eval_steps 15.1%, encode_call_args 13.7%, bind_executable_inputs 9.9%
- malloc and free about 20% (_xzm_free 11.4%, xzone_malloc 8.3%)
- select_clause 6.7%, dispatch_raw_event0 5.9%, enter_entry 5.2%, decode_backend_value_from_lanes 4.8%, retain_continuation_captures 4.1%, tuple_step_value 2.7%
- call_lowered_extern 1.5% (30 samples)

The ticket's targets:
- call_lowered_extern's per-call Vec, CString and dlsym: the program runs 12 executables and 12 frames per element and no extern on the hot path, so those 30 samples are not per-element work.
- Transport lane clones: decode_backend_value_from_lanes plus tuple_step_value are at most about 7.5% inclusive, overlapping the allocator share. This matches the proposal's 8%.

No single lever of 8% or more remains in the interpreter's per-call allocation. The allocator's 20% is spread across call argument encoding, input binding and frames.
title: A call on the interpreted path allocates nothing per call
